headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 13: Shriram Finance, Tata Motors PV fall 3%; Eicher Motors, Bharti Airtel rise over 1%
headlines.summary: On November 13, the 30-share BSE SENSEX declined by 318.55 points, or 0.39%, to close at 81,592.45. The 50-share NIFTY fell by 155.05 points, or 0.61%, to end at 25,144.30.

headlines.headline: Upcoming IPOs with shareholder quota: Reliance Retail, JSW One, IGX, Mahanadi Coalfields & more
headlines.summary: Many investors applied for the Jio Platforms IPO under the shareholder quota, which was reserved for eligible Reliance Industries shareholders. Mahanadi Coalfields, South Eastern Coalfields, Indian Gas Exchange, and Reliance Retail are among the list of upcoming IPOs likely to have a shareholder quota.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank shares fall over 1% amid market weakness; stock turns positive over 6 months
headlines.summary: HDFC Bank shares have shown signs of recovery after a challenging phase earlier this year, following several years of underperformance largely attributed to the merger of HDFC Ltd with the bank.

headlines.headline: SENSEX slides over 600 pts, NIFTY50 opens lower at 25,209 amid weak global cues; IndiGo, Jio Fin, HDFC Bank lead top losers
headlines.summary: The Indian stock market indices declined after a negative open on Friday, November 13, with investors booking profits amid weak global cues. Here are key things to know about today's fall.

headlines.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits: 7 Indian AI, semiconductor and data-centre stocks that could be in focus
headlines.summary: Semiconductor, AI and data-centre-linked stocks are likely to remain in focus and may see a knee-jerk reaction on Friday, November 13, amid concerns over the leadership transition at the global chipmaker.

headlines.headline: Market wrap, Nov 12: NIFTY50 ends at 25,229, SENSEX flat; NIFTY Smallcap 100 outperforms for second straight session
headlines.summary: HDFC Life Insurance (4.23%), Shriram Finance (3.58%), Bajaj Finance (3.36%), SBI Life Insurance (2.97%) and State Bank of India (2.97%) constituted the gainers’ pack on the NIFTY50 index,

headlines.headline: SENSEX off the day’s high, NIFTY trades flat in noon deals; Bajaj Finance, Cupid, Ola Electric among buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: Shares of Astra Microwave Products advanced as much as 6.2% to hit an intraday high of ₹1,835 apiece, as it reported a 113.72% increase in consolidated net profit to ₹51 crore in Q2 FY27, compared to ₹23.90 crore a year back.

headlines.headline: SBI, IOB, PNB shares fly high; NIFTY PSU Bank index surges 15% in a month
headlines.summary: While Indian Overseas Bank has received approval to raise up to ₹5,000 crore through a qualified institutional placement (QIP), Punjab & Sind Bank and Central Bank of India are also evaluating fundraising options.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX trade higher after negative open on Nov 12; M&M, Bharti Airtel, IT stocks among top losers
headlines.summary: Indian equity indices recovered their weak opening during the early hours on Thursday, November 12, as investors focues on the positive global cues amid FII support in the market.

headlines.headline: ITC shares rise 2% amid reports of cigarette price hikes; here is what we know so far
headlines.summary: According to news reports, ITC has raised the price of its Gold Flake RSFT cigarette pack by around 8% to ₹135 from ₹125 earlier, marking another price hike for the brand this year.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Nov 12: Bharat Dynamics, HAL, Bajaj Finance, Tata Power, Aurobindo Pharma, IRCTC, Page Industries
headlines.summary: Tata Power on Wednesday posted a record net profit of ₹1,652 crore for the September quarter (Q2 FY27), on the back of strong performance across all business segments.

headlines.headline: NIFTY Bank reclaims 61,000: HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, Federal Bank, other banking stocks rally up to 6%; here's why
headlines.summary: Banking stocks surging up to 6% powered the NIFTY Bank index to reclaim its position above 61,000 levels, near its lifetime high, as investors focus on the broader market rally amid FII buying support.

headlines.headline: HUL, ONGC, Godfrey Phillips, IRB Infra dividend record date on Nov 12: Last day to buy for payout
headlines.summary: HUL has declared an interim dividend of ₹19 per share, with a face value of ₹1 per share, for FY27. The record date is November 12. The company will pay the dividend to shareholders on November 25.

headlines.headline: Crude oil at 2-month low: HPCL, BPCL, Asian Paints, IndiGo shares rally; here's why
headlines.summary: Brent crude futures fell $1.08, or 1.2%, to settle at $91.49 per barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude declined 81 cents, or 0.9%, to $86.04 per barrel on Tuesday.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX rally over 1% after opening higher, IndiGo, M&M, among gainers; check factors behind today's surge
headlines.summary: Indian equity indices rallied over 1% after opening higher on Wednesday, November 11, with key focus on lower crude oil prices, massive FII buying support and positive geopolitical sentiment in the market.
